dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Tropical storm on Apr 04 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001268\_18](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001268) Tropical storm during the period Apr 04 2026-Apr 10 2026 in Solomon Islands, Papua New Guinea. The center of the storm was located near latitude -8.4 longitude 154.3. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
